text: In January 2026, the council consolidated ADQ's assets under L'IMAD Holding, one of the Government of Abu Dhabi's principal sovereign investment funds, whose portfolio now includes Etihad Airways.

source.name: Abu Dhabi Media Office: Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs Issues Resolution to Consolidate the Assets and Investments of L’IMAD Holding and Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Group
source.quote: Among these companies are TAQA, a major player in the power and water sector; Modon Properties; Etihad Airways; PureHealth; Etihad Rail; Wio Bank; Abu Dhabi Ports; McLaren; and Louis Dreyfus.

additionalSources.name: The National: Abu Dhabi to consolidate assets of ADQ under L'imad
additionalSources.quote: Among these companies are Taqa, Modon Properties, Etihad Airways, PureHealth, Etihad Rail, Wio Bank, Abu Dhabi Ports, McLaren and Louis Dreyfus.

additionalSources.name: ch-aviation: Etihad joins Abu Dhabi’s consolidated L'imad investment fund
additionalSources.quote: SCFEA oversees the principal sovereign investment funds of the Abu Dhabi government, namely the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Mubadala Investment Company, L'imad Holding Company, and the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company.
